methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units by identifying individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit was designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This involved breaking down complex sentences into simpler, more manageable statements. For the original research topic, the comments and the subsequent description were parsed to extract the core functionalities and constraints. For the generated technical specification, each section (header, combinational logic function, enhanced combinational description, timing logic summary) was analyzed to identify individual atomic units of information. Overlapping or redundant information was consolidated to ensure each atomic unit was unique and represented a distinct aspect of the system.
